scientific_limitations: Two equal instantaneous inputs, same two-stage linear-reservoir response, positive discharge threshold, no baseflow and infinite observation horizon.
The number of threshold-dependent winner reversals is not established; the maximum for each fixed threshold is fully classified.
No field calibration, nonlinear estuarine hydraulics, tidal phase, absolute flood-stage inference or historical priority guarantee.
